name: Window Nativizer
description: Brings native GNOME ergonomics and appearance to non-native windows. Seamlessly adds Adwaita-spec rounded corners, GPU-baked shadows, and a 12px GTK-aligned resize band — only where absent. Native libadwaita and libhandy apps are detected by reading /proc/<pid>/maps and left untouched: no Shell, Meta or Gio API exposes which decoration library a client links, since WM_CLASS and the app id are identity rather than toolkit, and libadwaita, libhandy and plain GTK differ only in the mapped libraries. Only that one file is read, once per process, and its contents are discarded after two membership tests. Nothing is sent anywhere; the only thing stored is the rule you set, together with the title of the window you picked it from, which the preferences window shows and matching never reads. Rules can be exported to and imported from the clipboard when you ask for it.
